title: 第13章 联手破敌第14章 拓印新剑法
lines: 林虎被云澈那一声低喝喊得一愣。
他习惯了自己猛打猛冲，脑子里就一个字：干！
现在突然冒出个人，让他别硬拼，还要找机会？这跟他平时的画风完全不搭啊！
但眼下这情况，由不得他多想。
狼群可不会给他们开会讨论战术的时间。
那头被石块打了鼻子的灰毛老狼，吃痛之下更加凶戾，低吼着就朝坏它好事的云澈扑来！
其他几头狼也重新围拢，绿油油的眼睛里全是嗜血的光。
“妈的，听你的！
怎么搞？”
林虎也是个干脆人，眼看云澈已经跟老狼对上，他立刻大吼一声，双手紧握阔剑，像个门神一样挡在云澈侧翼，警惕地盯着另外几头蠢蠢欲动的恶狼。
他虽然不明白这突然冒出来的家伙想干嘛，但直觉告诉他，这人或许有办法。
云澈没空回答他。
面对扑来的老狼，他根本不硬接。
只见他脚下像是装了滑轮，身形诡异的一滑一扭，老狼势在必得的一扑顿时落空，擦着他的衣角掠过。
就在老狼旧力已尽、新力未生的瞬间，云澈手中的断剑如同毒蛇出洞，快如闪电般刺向老狼相对柔软的腰腹部位！
“嗤啦！”
一声轻响，断剑虽然锈钝，但在云澈精准的力道和角度下，依然划开了一道不浅的血口子。
老狼吃痛，发出一声惨嚎。
这一下，不仅伤了老狼，更是把其他几头狼给镇住了。
它们发现这个新来的“小个子”
，不像那个大块头那么好对付，动作滑溜得很，专挑疼的地方下手。
有点东西啊！”
林虎眼睛一亮。
他看出来了，云澈的剑法跟他完全不是一个路数，精妙、刁钻，专门攻击狼的关节、眼睛、腰腹这些防御薄弱的地方，虽然单次伤害可能不如他阔剑劈砍来得猛，但效果却出奇的好！
“别光看着！
左侧那头，要上了！”
云澈低喝一声，提醒有些看呆了的林虎。
林虎一个激灵，果然看到左侧一头狼趁他分神，悄咪咪地想绕后偷袭。
他顿时怒了，感觉自己被看扁了，大吼一声：
“给老子滚开！”
阔剑带着一股恶风，拦腰横斩过去！
那狼吓得赶紧跳开，不敢硬接。
就这么一会儿工夫，云澈已经利用灵活的身法，又在一头试图夹击他的狼腿上留下了一道口子，引得那狼嗷嗷直叫。
“大个子，你力气大，负责正面压制！
吸引它们注意力！
我来找机会下手！”
云澈一边躲闪，一边快速喊道。
content_en:
Lin Hu was stunned by Yun Che's low shout.
He was used to hitting and rushing by himself, and there was only one word in his mind: Go!
Now someone suddenly appears and asks him not to fight hard but to look for opportunities? This doesn't match his usual style at all!
But in this situation, he couldn't think too much about it.
The wolves would not give them time to meet to discuss tactics.
The gray-haired old wolf whose nose was hit by a stone became even more ferocious under the pain. He roared and rushed towards Yun Che who had ruined his good deeds!
Several other wolves also gathered around again, their green eyes filled with bloodthirsty light.
“Damn it, listen to you!
What to do? "
Lin Hu was also a straightforward person. Seeing that Yun Che was already facing the old wolf, he immediately roared, holding the broad sword tightly with both hands, blocking Yun Che's flanks like a door god, and warily staring at the other wolves that were ready to move.
Although he didn't understand what this guy who suddenly appeared wanted to do, his intuition told him that this person might have a solution.
Yun Che had no time to answer him.
Faced with the charging old wolf, he didn't take it hard at all.
It was as if there were pulleys under his feet, and his figure was slipping and twisting strangely. The old wolf's inevitable pounce suddenly missed, grazing the corner of his clothes.
At the moment when the old wolf's old strength was exhausted and the new strength had not yet been regenerated, the broken sword in Yun Che's hand was like a poisonous snake coming out of its hole, and it stabbed into the relatively soft waist and abdomen of the old wolf as fast as lightning!
"Tsk!"
There was a soft sound, and although the broken sword was rusty and dull, under Yun Che's precise strength and angle, it still opened a large bloody gash.
"Ouch!"
The old wolf was in pain and let out a miserable howl.
This time, he not only injured the old wolf, but also suppressed several other wolves.
They discovered this new "little man"
, not as easy to deal with as the big guy, his movements are very slippery, and he specializes in picking the painful places to attack.
"Hey!
There is something! "
Lin Hu's eyes lit up.
He could see that Yun Che's swordsmanship was completely different from his. It was exquisite and tricky, and specialized in attacking weak defense areas such as the wolf's joints, eyes, waist and abdomen. Although the single damage might not be as severe as his broad sword's slash, the effect was surprisingly good!
"Don't just look at it!
The left end is coming! "
Yun Che shouted lowly, reminding Lin Hu who was a little stunned.
Lin Hu was startled, and he saw a wolf on the left, taking advantage of his distraction, to quietly sneak around and attack him.
He suddenly became angry, feeling that he was being looked down upon, and yelled:
"Get out of my way!"
The broad sword carried an evil wind and slashed across the waist!
The wolf was so frightened that he jumped away quickly, not daring to confront him forcefully.
In just a short while, Yun Che had already used his flexible body skills to leave a gash in the leg of a wolf that was trying to attack him, causing the wolf to howl.
"Big man, you are strong and responsible for frontal suppression!
Get their attention!
I'll look for an opportunity to start! "
Yun Che shouted quickly while dodging.
title_en: Chapter 13 Join forces to defeat the enemy Chapter 14 Rubbing new sword skills
